response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced Staff/Senior engineer with 15+ years across web, embedded, and infrastructure, but this is dramatically overqualified and mismatched for a junior/mid-level entry role. His skills (TypeScript, React, Node.js, PostgreSQL-adjacent SQL) technically cover the requirements, but his seniority, compensation expectations, and career trajectory strongly suggest poor fit and likely rapid disengagement or turnover risk in an entry-level IC position.
strengths: Extensive TypeScript/Node.js and React experience directly matching required stack
Strong software craftsmanship background (TDD, CI/CD, clean architecture) exceeding 'nice-to-have' interest in clean architecture
Proven ability to work across full stack and diverse domains (fintech, adtech, geo-data, embedded)
concerns: Severely overqualified — Staff/Senior level applying to a junior/mid entry-level role
No PostgreSQL experience listed (MongoDB, MySQL only), and no direct experience in renewable energy/construction domain
Likely mismatch in expectations around compensation, autonomy, and role scope; risk of quick exit once a senior role appears

key_factors.factor: Strong core tech stack alignment (TypeScript, React, Node.js)
No direct PostgreSQL or domain-specific (energy/construction) experience
